# `aitbc simulate price`

Simulate AIT price movements with configurable volatility.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc simulate price [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--price` | float | `100.0` | no | Starting AIT price |
| `--volatility` | float | `0.05` | no | Price volatility (0.0-1.0) |
| `--timesteps` | integer | `100` | no | Number of timesteps to simulate |
| `--delay` | float | `0.1` | no | Delay between timesteps (seconds) |
| `--seed` | integer | — | no | Seed for deterministic simulation (default: live) |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc simulate price
```
